instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read all sections in design_guidelines.json and follow the layout hierarchy strictly.
2. Maintain strict data-testid attributes on all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive tabs.
3. Implement smooth tab switching between all 5 majors (RPL, DKV, Bisnis Digital, MP, AKL) with rich curriculum & job prospects details.
4. Include interactive PPDB registration modal or calculator that allows prospective students to submit a test registration / inquiry with Sonner toast feedback.
5. Include CBT link button pointing to https://ujiango.smk-terataiputih2.sch.id/ in the Agenda and Header shortcuts.
6. Include direct WhatsApp chat triggers to +6281398865871 and +6285777835093 with prefilled friendly Indonesian greeting text.
7. Include YouTube embed modal or responsive video player for the official profile video (ID: DtyvJvqRdpY).
8. Ensure the website has Indonesian language as primary with modern, polished grammar and high-trust academic presentation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure high contrast ratios: Dark blue and slate headers with crisp white text, white cards on slate-50 backgrounds.
Do NOT use generic blank placeholders; use curated images provided in image_urls.
Ensure all dialogs, select dropdowns, and tabs have solid backgrounds without see-through refractions.
Add generous padding (py-16 to py-24 per section) to ensure content breathes naturally on mobile and desktop.
